description: This file defines a Java interface named Troubleable, which declares methods for checking and setting a trouble state on a device.

classes.name: Troubleable
classes.description: A Java interface that includes method signatures for querying and setting the trouble status of a device.

methods.name: isTroubled
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the device is troubled.

methods.name: setTroubled
methods.description: Sets the trouble status of the device given a boolean value.
